title: IVG Intense Salts Lemon Lime 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: IVG Intense Salts Lemon Lime delivers a citrus mix that balances the sharpness of Lemon with the tang of Lime. The combination is clean and refreshingly tart, cutting through with clarity from start to finish. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this Nic Salt ensures strong flavour, discreet vapour, and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, Lemon Lime is designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) devices such as pod kits, vape pens and starter systems. Part of the IVG Intense Salts range, Lemon Lime is a distinctive choice for fans of sharp, citrus flavours.
